metadata.question: Did the total water surface area within a 5 km radius of Agudo, Brazil increase between November 5, 2023 and November 21, 2023?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about water surface area change within a 5km radius of Agudo, Brazil between November 5, 2023 and November 21, 2023. Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery for water detection (best spatial resolution for this scale) 2. Create a 5km buffer around Agudo, Brazil coordinates 3. Use MNDWI (Modified Normalized Difference Water Index) for water detection 4. Compare water area between the two dates 5. Handle cloud masking and data availability checks Important considerations: - Use specific coordinates for Agudo, Brazil (approximately -29.6447, -53.2500) - Create 5km buffer around point - Use 3-day windows around each target date to ensure data availability - Calculate water area using pixel counting and area calculation - Validate data availability and pixel counts For water detection: - MNDWI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) using B3 and B11 bands - Threshold > 0 typically indicates water Need to handle: - Cloud masking using QA60 band - Data availability checks (C1 if no images) - Valid pixel checks (C2 if all masked) - Calculation validation (C3 if invalid results) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const agudo = ee.Geometry.Point([-53.2500, -29.6447]); const studyArea = agudo.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer // Date ranges (3-day windows around target dates) const date1_start = '2023-11-04'; const date1_end = '2023-11-06'; const date2_start = '2023-11-20'; const date2_end = '2023-11-22'; // 2. Data Acquisition function getSentinel2Collection(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(studyArea) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); } const col1 = getSentinel2Collection(date1_start, date1_end); const col2 = getSentinel2Collection(date2_start, date2_end); const col1_size = col1.size().getInfo(); const col2_size = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Nov 5 window Images: ${col1_size}`); console.log(`Nov 21 window Images: ${col2_size}`); // Check for empty collections if (col1_size === 0 || col2_size === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create composites and calculate water area function calculateWaterArea(imageCollection) { // Create median composite const composite = imageCollection.median(); // Calculate MNDWI for water detection (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) const mndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']); // Create water mask (MNDWI > 0 typically indicates water) const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0); // Calculate water area in square meters const waterArea = waterMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: studyArea, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('nd'); return waterArea; } const area1 = calculateWaterArea(col1); const area2 = calculateWaterArea(col2); // Get the actual values const area1_val = area1.getInfo(); const area2_val = area2.getInfo(); console.log(`Nov 5 water area: ${area1_val ? (area1_val / 1000000).toFixed(2) : 'None'} km²`); console.log(`Nov 21 water area: ${area2_val ? (area2_val / 1000000).toFixed(2) : 'None'} km²`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (area1_val === null || area2_val === null || isNaN(area1_val) || isNaN(area2_val)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (area1_val === 0 || area2_val === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (area2_val > area1_val) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
